content.short: Monetrix issues USDM, a yield-bearing stable token native to Hyperliquid.
content.description: Monetrix issues USDM, a stable token that accrues yield to its holder and is native to Hyperliquid. Backing comes from basis trading positions, not fiat reserves held off-chain, so the yield originates from funding rather than Treasury interest. Holding the token is enough to receive the yield, with no separate staking step.
content.meta: USDM, a stable token that pays yield to the holder, backed by basis positions rather than reserves.
